app.name: Core Hub
app.tagline: Core Hub reference client: a terminal client over the contract.

usage.legacy_env: {names} is the old Majlis name; it still works, but rename it to {renamed}.
usage.legacy_command: `majlis` is the old name of this command; it still works, but use `corehub`.
usage.secret_argument: {option} is not accepted on the command line; the value is asked for interactively.
usage.exit_codes: Exit codes: 0 ok · 1 error · 2 usage · 3 not signed in.

option.server: Hub origin, e.g. https://hub.example (remembered at login)
option.json: Print the contract's JSON instead of text
option.strict: Validate every realtime envelope against its schema; stop at the first mismatch
option.lang: Output language: ar or en (default: COREHUB_LANG, then LANG)
option.connection: How the device reaches the hub: lan or relay
option.no_qr: Do not draw the QR code
option.pairing_id: Pairing id printed by `corehub pair` (when CODE is not the QR JSON)
option.device_name: Name to register this computer under
option.kind: Filter by agent kind: hermes, acp, harness or builtin
option.title: Session title
option.working_dir: Working directory on the hub host
option.message: Send this message instead of reading from the terminal
option.once: Exit when the first run finishes (with --message)
option.reasoning: Show the agent's reasoning as it streams
option.approve: Answer approvals without asking: once, session, always or deny
option.timeout: Give up waiting for a run after this many seconds (0 = never)
option.provider_kind: Only providers of this kind: llm, stt or tts.
option.model_kind: Only models of this kind: chat, embedding, stt or tts.
option.role: Which default to set: chat (the default), coding, title, summary or embedding.
option.display_name: Display name for the owner (asked for when omitted)
option.workspace_name: Name of the first profile (asked for when omitted)
option.base_url: The endpoint's base URL (required when the preset has no default).
option.provider_name: A name for this provider, instead of the preset label.
option.no_key: Add it without asking for a key.
option.clear_key: Forget the stored key but keep the provider.
option.purpose: What the file is for: message, avatar, task, import, background, skill or release
option.out: Where to write it; `-` writes to stdout
option.attach: Attach a local file to the first message (repeatable)

cmd.setup: Create the owner account on a hub that has none yet
cmd.login: Sign in to a hub and remember the token
cmd.logout: Revoke the token and forget it
cmd.pair: Start QR pairing for another device and wait for it
cmd.pair_claim: Claim a pairing from this computer (the device side)
cmd.agents_install: Install an agent's CLI on the hub (a job)
cmd.sessions_show: Show a session with its live state
cmd.chat: Chat in a session and stream the reply
cmd.providers_list: List the providers this profile added, with their address and whether a key is stored.
cmd.providers_add: Add a provider from a preset, or store a key for one you already added.
cmd.providers_test: Ask the provider whether the stored key works.
cmd.providers_remove: Remove a provider, or (--clear-key) only forget its stored key.
cmd.models_list: List the models the providers reported.
cmd.models_default: Show the profile's default models, or set one.
cmd.providers_presets: List the provider types you can add, local model servers included.
cmd.files_upload: Upload a file and print its attachment id
cmd.files_download: Download an attachment to a file (or `-` for stdout)
cmd.files_delete: Delete an attachment no message references yet

arg.code: Pairing code (XXXX-XXXX) or the full QR JSON
arg.model_key: Model key as `<provider>/<model>`; omit to show the current defaults.
arg.provider_or_preset: A provider you already added, or a preset id from `providers presets`.

errors.not_signed_in: Not signed in. Run `corehub login --server URL` first.
errors.server_required: No hub is configured. Pass --server URL.
errors.setup_required: The hub has no owner account yet. Run `corehub setup --server URL` (the setup token from its log is asked for only once the open window has ended), or open the hub in a browser.
errors.not_implemented: The hub declares {operation} in the contract but does not implement it yet [not_implemented, HTTP 501].
errors.envelope_invalid: A realtime envelope does not match its schema ({event}): {problems}
errors.pairing_id_required: Pass the QR JSON, or the code together with --pairing-id.
errors.pairing_json_invalid: That JSON is not a Core Hub pairing payload.
errors.config_invalid: The config file {file} is not valid JSON.
errors.setup_done: This hub is already set up. Run `corehub login --server URL` instead.
errors.password_mismatch: The two passwords are not the same; nothing was sent.

setup.open: {server} has no owner yet and setup is OPEN to whoever arrives first until {until} — no token needed. Finish it now.
setup.where: {server} has no account yet. Its setup token was printed once in the hub log and written to setup-token.txt in its data directory (docker compose logs hub, or docker compose exec hub cat /data/setup-token.txt).
setup.success: Owner account {username} created on {server} and signed in. Profile: {profile}.

logout.nothing: Not signed in; nothing to do.

pair.scan: Scan the QR with the Core Hub app, or on the other device run:
pair.expired: The pairing expired before a device claimed it.
pair.claim_success: This computer is paired as {username} on {server}.

sessions.created: Session {id} created. Chat with: corehub chat {id}
sessions.title: Title

chat.hint: Type a message and press Enter. Ctrl+C stops the run; a second Ctrl+C exits.
chat.cancelling: Stopping the run … (Ctrl+C again to exit)
chat.resync: The hub could not replay everything; re-reading the session.
chat.waiting_run: A run is already active; waiting for it.
chat.timeout_hint: The run is still active on the hub.

models.label: Name
models.empty: No models yet. Add a provider key and the hub fetches its model list.
models.providers_empty: No providers added yet. `corehub providers presets` lists what you can add.
models.shared_note: Every agent uses this key; you do not enter it again per agent.
models.prompt_key_optional: API key for {provider} (optional, Enter to skip):
models.provider_added: Provider {provider} added at {url}. Its model list is being fetched.
models.base_url_required: This provider has no default address; pass --base-url.
models.key_required_for: {provider} needs a key to answer; nothing was stored.
models.container_note: The hub runs in a container: 127.0.0.1 here is the container, not your machine.
models.loopback_warning: This address is loopback, and the hub runs in a container: it will reach the container itself. Try {url} (and add {alias} to the stack on a Linux host).

files.name: Name
files.too_large: The file is larger than the hub accepts ({max} bytes).
